baseline_models.focus_anchor: The conditional chain from أَوْلِيَاءُ لِلَّهِ مِن دُونِ النَّاسِ to فَتَمَنَّوُا الْمَوْتَ and صَادِقِينَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The claim draws a boundary around gapless divine proximity and places the human collective outside it. The imperative then directs desire toward loss of embodied life, so the alleged relation is tested at the point where its remaining distance should collapse. Truth is not merely accurate description here; its action-realizing branch makes willingness to approach the claimed endpoint the assay of the claim.

activation_trace.role: Gapless nearness supplies the spatial content of the claimed divine relation.
Otherness supplies the excluding boundary drawn around that relation.
The visible human collective supplies the population placed beyond the claimed boundary.
A wish pictured by the heart turns asserted nearness into a test of desired direction.
Loss of force and life supplies the terminal object toward which the claimed nearness is tested.
Truth realized through fulfillment makes the condition behavioral rather than merely verbal.

changed_reading.before: A polemical instruction to wish for death after claiming special divine friendship.
changed_reading.after: A claimed topology of exclusive nearness is stress-tested at its endpoint: desire discloses whether the claimant actually wants the proximity asserted.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: إِن زَعَمْتُمْ أَنَّكُمْ أَوْلِيَاءُ لِلَّهِ ... إِن كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The less obvious guarantee branch of زعم lets the assertion function as an undertaking. The claimed ولاية combines office and entitlement; the paired imperative calls the undertaking by asking the claimants to accept the measured consequence rather than retain its privilege. صدق closes the circuit as fulfillment in action. The verse can therefore operate like a performance bond: the claim incurs liability to enact what it implies.

activation_trace.role: Guarantee and surety turn the uttered claim into an undertaking that can be called in.
Taking charge of an affair gives the claimed status an office with duties.
Priority and entitlement supply the privilege side whose corresponding liability is being tested.
Measurement and executed decree make the demanded consequence exact rather than rhetorical.
Self-surrender to an affair, even unto death, supplies the performance demanded by the bond.
Fulfillment by deed defines the criterion by which the undertaking succeeds or fails.

changed_reading.before: The claim is an assertion whose sincerity is checked by an extreme wish.
changed_reading.after: The claim is also a self-incurred guarantee: claiming divine office and priority exposes the claimant to the consequence that would verify it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: الَّذِينَ هَادُوا ... أَوْلِيَاءُ لِلَّهِ مِن دُونِ النَّاسِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Alongside the group designation, the mapped direction branch of هادوا activates people defined by a course or orientation. Their claim joins approach toward God to دون, whose spatial branch can mean near but still short of the goal. The death imperative then tests whether a direction has been mistaken for arrival: are they willing to continue to the destination, or are they protecting a prestigious intermediate position?

activation_trace.role: Direction, course, and intended way activate a group identity understood as orientation.
Turning the face and approaching gives that orientation an enacted vector toward God.
Nearness that remains below or short of the goal introduces spatial irony into the exclusive claim.
The decreed end supplies the destination against which the claimed direction is measured.
Actual loss of life prevents the destination from remaining a purely honorific metaphor.
Stability and completed soundness distinguish arrived orientation from an unstable claim.

changed_reading.before: A named community claims to have a uniquely favored relation to God.
changed_reading.after: The group-name carries directional irony: those claiming nearest arrival may be only near-but-short, and death tests whether their course truly reaches its professed end.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قُلْ, زَعَمْتُمْ, تَمَنَّوُا, and صَادِقِينَ form a chain of speech, claim, requested desire, and verification.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus ayah contains several ways language can detach from reality: an uttered command, an uncertain report, a wish that can become fabricated discourse, and even a death-like display that can be feigned. The final truth condition blocks the easy response of merely saying the requested words. The test concerns alignment of speech, inward desire, and existential posture, not production of another formula.

activation_trace.role: Audible utterance opens a scene in which words themselves are the testing medium.
Speech without certainty marks the original claim as potentially detached from fact.
The fabricated-wish branch keeps the commanded wish from being satisfied by a newly invented verbal posture.
Feigning death or humility supplies the bodily analogue of speech that only performs sincerity.
Correspondence of statement, inward state, and reported reality closes the simulacrum trap.

changed_reading.before: The imperative can sound like a demand to pronounce a death wish.
changed_reading.after: The verse anticipates verbal compliance as another possible fiction; it asks whether claim, desire, and lived posture coincide.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening ayah places everything in the heavens and earth in God-directed activity and names divine ownership and disposal. Against that field, أَوْلِيَاءُ لِلَّهِ cannot safely mean that a cohort privately possesses the divine relation. Its viable office-sense is delegated standing under a universal sovereign; the exclusive boundary becomes a jurisdictional overclaim rather than merely an inflated affection.

activation_trace.role: Office and administration supply the focus claim that sovereignty now places under authority.
Exclusion supplies the attempted privatization of that office away from other people.
Exoneration and purification resist enclosing God within a claimant-defined relation.
Ownership with power of disposal supplies the higher jurisdiction that no cohort can appropriate.

structural_cues: The universal merism ما في السماوات وما في الأرض precedes the exclusive claim.
The divine titles in 62:1 accumulate authority before 62:6 tests a human status assertion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies universal God-directed activity, exoneration, and ownership; I infer that these constrain claimed ولاية as delegated rather than possessed and expose مِن دُونِ النَّاسِ as privatization. A live alternative is that universal sovereignty and a genuinely exclusive favor could coexist without contradiction.

changed_reading.before: The verse disputes which group enjoys special divine friendship.
changed_reading.after: It also disputes whether any group can treat service under universal sovereignty as privately owned jurisdiction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence opens a community, then names later or other people who have not yet caught up, then calls the enabling relation a gift. This activates the near-but-short branch of دون in 62:6: the self-declared nearest group may be stalled before the goal, while people currently placed outside the boundary remain capable of catching up. Exclusivity becomes a temporal snapshot falsely hardened into an essence.

activation_trace.role: Nearness supplies the contested position on a shared trajectory.
Being near yet short of the goal turns claimed superiority into possible incompletion.
A community or kind supplies an initial recipient group without making it the endpoint of access.
Laterness and otherness make the allegedly excluded population temporally open.
A later mover catching what is ahead supplies the reversal of a fixed rank boundary.
Gift and benefaction make nearness received rather than inherited or monopolized.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from a messenger within one group in 62:2, to others not yet joined in 62:3, to favor granted by divine will in 62:4.
The motion in 62:3 points toward an occupied position rather than a sealed caste boundary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies community, later others, catching up, and gift; I map their forward motion onto the focus ayah's nearness and near-but-short branches. The live alternative keeps دون in its ordinary excluding sense and treats the later others as unrelated to the claimants' rank.

changed_reading.before: مِن دُونِ النَّاسِ marks a stable privilege over everyone else.
changed_reading.after: The supposedly excluded others can be future catchers-up, while a claimant who calls itself nearest may still be short of the goal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The threefold carrying sequence in 62:5 separates assignment of a burden, actual carrying, and mere external transport. This materializes the performance-bond baseline: a claimant to divine office must transmit entrusted writing into enacted responsibility. The death demand is no longer an isolated extreme dare; it exposes the same gap already visible when a title is borne but its load is not carried.

activation_trace.role: Surety makes the focus claim answerable for an entrusted obligation.
Taking charge supplies the office whose burden must actually be borne.
Fulfillment in action supplies the successful transfer from title to performance.
The struck comparison licenses a material carrying mechanism rather than a loose thematic parallel.
Visible lifting supplies the external possession of scripture or status.
Bearing responsibility supplies the missing inward and practical carriage.
A book that discloses writing supplies the content that must pass from load into life.
Falsehood names the mismatch between the borne title and failed enactment.

structural_cues: 62:5 repeats حمل in passive assignment, negated performance, and animal transport immediately before the claim in 62:6.
The parable moves from legal-scriptural possession to a bodily load, giving the claim a material failure mode.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit comparison, external load, responsibility, disclosed writing, and falsehood; I infer that the adjacent claim of ولاية is another entrusted burden whose truth requires carriage into action. A live alternative confines 62:5 to scripture and reads the death challenge as a separate polemical proof.

changed_reading.before: The death wish is the single decisive test of a privileged title.
changed_reading.after: The title has already become a load-bearing office: the extreme test reveals a prior failure to carry entrusted meaning into action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated wish is negated and causally tied to what hands have sent ahead. Death thereby becomes a settlement point for an already funded account: the claimant does not merely fear cessation but resists meeting its own prior deposits. The no-departure branch of أبدا sharpens refusal into immobilization, while the focus truth branch asks whether claim and accumulated action can occupy the same ledger.

activation_trace.role: Loss of life supplies the settlement threshold named by the focus challenge.
Action that realizes a claim supplies the required match between account and assertion.
The repeated heart-imaged wish is now explicitly refused, converting the hypothetical test into observed recoil.
Remaining in place and not departing gives the refusal a spatially immobilized quality.
Advancing something ahead turns past conduct into material already waiting beyond the threshold.
What the hands have earned assigns the forwarded material to the claimants' own agency.

structural_cues: 62:7 repeats تمني under negation and follows it with the causal phrase بما قدمت أيديهم.
The move from conditional second person in 62:6 to predicted refusal in 62:7 turns a proposed test into a diagnosis.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies refused desire, nondeparture, forward movement, and hand-earned action; I infer a ledger in which death is the point of meeting prior deposits. The live alternative is a simpler causal reading in which bad deeds produce fear without the stronger settlement metaphor.

changed_reading.before: The test asks whether the claimants possess enough confidence to welcome death.
changed_reading.after: It asks whether they are ready to settle with what their own hands have already placed ahead of them.

context_deltas.mechanism: In 62:6 the addressees are grammatical agents invited to direct desire toward death; in 62:8 they flee while death becomes the encounterer, after which they are passively returned. This reverses the vector of the test. Desire cannot summon or control the endpoint; it reveals posture toward an encounter whose agency and timing lie elsewhere.

activation_trace.role: Projected desire initially makes the claimants appear to direct themselves toward death.
Fulfillment through action makes directional posture evidential.
The repeated loss of life becomes the active pole of the encounter rather than a wished-for object alone.
Flight supplies the inverse movement that exposes the asserted desire.
Two things arriving face-to-face makes escape and pursuit converge in an unavoidable meeting.
Return to a prior point removes the fugitives' control over the journey's destination.

structural_cues: Death is the object of تَمَنَّوُا in 62:6 but the subject represented by مُلَاقِيكُمْ in 62:8.
The sequence runs from command, to negated response, to flight, encounter, and passive return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the grammatical and kinetic reversal from wishing toward death to fleeing a death that meets and a return imposed on the fugitives; I infer that the challenge exposes imagined control over proximity and timing. A live alternative reads 62:8 only as confirmation that avoidance is futile.

changed_reading.before: The claimants can validate themselves by choosing to call death toward them.
changed_reading.after: Their choice does not govern the encounter; the test reveals whether their declared orientation survives when death is the one coming toward them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final movement of 62:8 supplies a verification apparatus for صادقين. What is hidden and what is witnessed are held in one knowing, then news of intended action is delivered back to the actors. Truth is therefore more than sincerity at the instant of claiming: it is eventual agreement among speech, concealed motive, visible conduct, and the report returned to the claimant.

activation_trace.role: An uncertain report supplies the proposition that requires verification.
Correspondence between statement, inward state, and reality supplies the verification criterion.
Disclosure to a knower supplies cognition capable of spanning all sides of the claim.
What is veiled from eyes supplies the concealed motive or state unavailable to public claims.
Presence with observation supplies the publicly inspectable side of conduct.
A delivered report returns the verified account to those who authored the claim.
Intended action supplies the durable evidence against which speech is measured.

structural_cues: The return in 62:8 terminates not merely in death but in being informed of prior action.
The paired unseen/witnessed domains widen the evidence beyond both public performance and private self-report.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies uncertain speech, correspondence, concealed and observed domains, delivered news, and intentional action; I infer that 62:8 unfolds the audit implicit in صادقين. A live alternative treats the disclosure as a general judgment scene rather than the specific mechanism of the 62:6 conditional.

changed_reading.before: صادقين asks whether the current assertion is sincere.
changed_reading.after: صادقين anticipates a total disclosure in which speech, hidden motive, witnessed conduct, and returned report must agree.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later imperatives stage a coordinated rhythm: hear a public call, gather, move purposefully, suspend exchange, then after completion spread out and seek. This keeps the death challenge from becoming an invitation to despise embodied or social life. Claimed nearness is tested by repeated relinquishment and reentry within communal time: one must be able to leave commerce for remembrance and then return to seeking without turning either withdrawal or acquisition into an absolute.

activation_trace.role: Nearness supplies the relation whose practical rhythm the later imperatives display.
The human collective anchors the challenge against a private flight from communal life.
Loss of life supplies the extreme relinquishment that the ordinary cadence now reframes.
The raised public call interrupts private trajectories and initiates coordinated movement.
A day, place, or summons that gathers people gives nearness a collective time-space.
Purposeful motion toward a sought object makes orientation visible in conduct.
Leaving something supplies a finite, repeatable practice of relinquishment.
Exchange for price supplies the ordinary attachment temporarily released rather than permanently condemned.
Completion marks a temporal hinge instead of an absolute withdrawal.
Opening, spreading, and branching return the gathered group to distributed life.
Renewed seeking keeps worldly agency inside, rather than outside, the disciplined relation.

structural_cues: The plural imperatives move through call, gathering, leaving, completion, dispersal, and seeking.
Commerce is suspended in 62:9 but seeking provision resumes in 62:10, preventing a one-way flight from life.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a public call and an ordered gather-leave-complete-disperse-seek cadence; I infer that these downstream imperatives constrain the death command as a diagnostic of ordered attachment rather than ascetic escape. A live alternative treats 62:9-10 as an independent communal rule with no backward pressure on 62:6.

changed_reading.before: Readiness for death appears to be the privileged relation's decisive positive expression.
changed_reading.after: The relation is also expressed by repeatedly releasing and reentering ordinary life at the right time, among people, without absolutizing either retreat or gain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final scene spatializes the focus claim. Diversion occupies attention, the gathering breaks apart, the speaker is left standing, and then what is near or present with God is contrasted with the attractive objects. Thus claimed ولاية is tested in a mundane vector of movement: where bodies and attention go when competing provision appears. The repeated قُلْ links the spectacular death test to this ordinary assay of remaining, leaving, and trusting the provider.

activation_trace.role: Gapless proximity supplies the claim that the final scene renders as actual placement of attention and bodies.
Exclusion supplies the boast that practical movement toward other objects destabilizes.
Fulfillment in action lets ordinary movement verify or falsify the claimed relation.
Profit-seeking supplies the competing source of expected good toward which the crowd moves.
Being occupied away from one thing by another supplies the attentional mechanism of false proximity.
A gathering breaking apart converts divided attention into visible social geometry.
Abandonment supplies the enacted opposite of loyal nearness.
Bodily standing supplies the fixed relational point from which the crowd departs.
The repeated spoken command explicitly recalls the testing speech of 62:6.
Nearness and presence at God provide a contextual spatial counterpart to the claimed ولاية.
Allocated gift relocates economic trust from the visible attraction to the divine provider.

structural_cues: قُلْ frames both 62:6 and 62:11, linking the two confrontations.
The crowd moves toward commerce and diversion, leaves the speaker standing, and is answered with a comparative about what is عند الله.
The scene converts an abstract relation to God into observable direction under competing attraction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies distraction, dispersal, abandonment, standing, nearness at God, and allocated provision; I infer that the final scene is a low-intensity behavioral version of the focus ayah's death test. A live alternative notes the shift in address and treats the scene only as an analogy rather than direct evidence about the claimants in 62:6.

changed_reading.before: Exclusive divine nearness is tested only by willingness to face the ultimate threshold.
changed_reading.after: The same nearness is continuously tested by the direction of attention and movement when a nearer-looking profit or diversion appears.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the rare saddle-padding branch of و ل ي through the immediately preceding donkey-and-load scene, not the ordinary relational sense of أَوْلِيَاءُ. It remains anchored in that exact focus word and in 62:5's explicit carrying mechanism. Downstream prose should present it only as a material diagnostic analogy: a prestigious title can cushion carriage without making the carrier assimilate the load.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَوْلِيَاءُ in 62:6 immediately after the load-bearing parable of 62:5.

activation_trace.role: Padding beneath a saddle supplies an unusual material image for a title interposed between bearer and burden.
External lifting supplies the burden that can be transported without inward appropriation.
The donkey supplies the actual saddle-bearing body that activates the focus word's remote material branch.

changed_reading.before: أَوْلِيَاءُ is solely a relational honor claimed by the speakers.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the honor can behave like padding beneath an external scriptural load: it makes possession bearable while concealing non-assimilation, which the death test strips bare.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it cross-activates remote branches of ق ض ي and ن ش ر inside instructions about completed prayer and dispersal. It remains anchored to the focus pairing of estimated death and explicit death, and to the exact later sequence of completion followed by spreading. It must be rendered as a rhythmic echo, never as a claim that the surface instruction literally says death or resurrection.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The paired تقدير/منية and موت possibilities in فَتَمَنَّوُا الْمَوْتَ, echoed by completion then spreading in 62:10.

activation_trace.role: A decreed death folds the focus wish into the semantic field of an appointed ending.
Actual loss of life keeps the later analogy tethered to the explicit focus object.
Death as an executed decree supplies a remote terminal resonance within the act of completion.
Reviving the dead supplies the remote reopening resonance immediately after that completion.

changed_reading.before: The focus demands a singular willingness to cross the final endpoint.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the later completion-and-spreading cadence rehearses ending and renewed life, making truthfulness visible in repeated small relinquishments before the final one.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the recitation branch of م ن ي rather than taking تَمَنَّوُا as anything other than wishing at surface level. It remains anchored in the exact focus verb and is strengthened by the earlier recital-and-book sequence. Downstream prose should qualify it as secondary wordplay: the claimants are challenged to read their own claim through to its terminal consequence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تَمَنَّوُا within a speech-and-claim chain, after the recital and book sequence of 62:2.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech supplies the frame in which the claim can be treated as a script being voiced.
An uncertain report supplies the claim whose ending has not yet been existentially accepted.
Reading or reciting a text activates the challenge as carrying the claim's own script through to its last line.
Following in sequence supplies the earlier recital movement that lets a claim be read onward to consequence.
Writing that fixes an obligation supplies the script whose assertion incurs a binding ending.

changed_reading.before: The imperative asks the claimants to form a sincere wish for death.
changed_reading.after: As secondary wordplay, it asks them to read their own privileged claim all the way through to the death-consequence written into it, rather than stopping at its honorific opening.

strongest_changes: Universal sovereignty and gifted access turn exclusive ولاية from private possession into a delegated and temporally open relation.
The carrying parable converts the claim into a load-bearing office whose truth appears in enacted responsibility.
Forwarded deeds and the pursuing death turn a voluntary wish-test into readiness to meet an already accumulated account.
The unseen/witnessed disclosure expands صادقين from present sincerity into eventual agreement among claim, motive, conduct, and report.
The gather-disperse cadence and the final pull of commerce relocate divine nearness into ordinary patterns of attention, relinquishment, return, and trust.
summary.what_was_special: The most productive activations were reversals rather than themes: near could still mean short while later others catch up; a privileged title became a carried liability; people invited to move toward death became fugitives met by it; and abstract nearness was rendered as the visible direction of a dispersing crowd. The rare saddle-padding, decree/revival, and recitation branches were retained as contained material and rhythmic outliers rather than allowed to replace the surface reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The ordinary group-name, exclusion, wish, and death senses remain primary; directional, near-but-short, recitational, and material branches are deliberately exploratory overlays.
The later communal imperatives address a different named audience, so their backward illumination of 62:6 may be analogical rather than directly predicative.
The performance-bond and ledger mechanisms fit the branch sequence strongly, but the exact relation between inward desire and externally observable fulfillment remains underdetermined.
The saddle-padding and completion/revival outliers depend on cross-domain resonance and should not be flattened into lexical translation.
